DevOps Bootcamp Capstone

Team 2 — "It Works on Our Machines"

An end-to-end automated deployment pipeline: from an idea typed on a board, through GitHub and Jenkins, to a live website running on AWS.

Solution Architecture

flowchart LR
    Dev["Developer / Board"] -->|git push| GH["GitHub Repo"]
    GH -->|Poll SCM| J["Jenkins Pipeline"]
    J --> B["Build Docker Image"]
    B --> ECR[("Amazon ECR")]
    ECR --> D["Deploy Container
EC2 : port 80"]
    J --> S3[("Amazon S3
static site")]
    D --> Smoke["Smoke Test
HTTP 200"]

    subgraph Provisioning["One-time provisioning"]
      TF["Terraform (IaC)"] --> EC2[("AWS EC2")]
      ANS["Ansible (config)"] --> EC2
    end

Terraform builds the server · Ansible configures it · Jenkins builds a Docker image · stores it in ECR · deploys to EC2 and S3 · then a smoke test proves the site is up.

Live Demo

Part 1 — Input

Type a requirement

Submitting sends it to the local backend, which edits the site and pushes to GitHub.

Part 2 — Deployment

Watch it go live

  1. Jenkins detects the push (Poll SCM).
  2. Pipeline runs: build → ECR → EC2 + S3.
  3. A new card appears on the live site.
